package.name: big_bertha_bringup
package.description: Hardware bringup for the physical Big Bertha quadruped (Arduino UNO Q, MG995 servos, YDLidar X2, MPU6050). Empty stub for now: the README documents the real BOM (see PLAN.md sec 11) so the hardware bringup mirrors the sim modules. The autonomy stack (state_estimation, mapping, localization, planning) is hardware-agnostic and reused with use_sim_time:=false; only the sensor drivers and the servo bridge replace the simulation layer.
